items.title: Northstar Ops - Web Exploit Writeup
items.summary:
TL;DR Northstar Ops - Web Exploit Writeup is a web challenge from CBD. In this challenge, the targets given are: Summary In this challenge, the targets given are:
https://northstar.cbd2026.cloud/ My goal is to find weaknesses in the web application and retrieve the flag. After performing enumeration and analyzing the application’s behavior, I discovered that the service in front of the application uses a custom Python proxy that performs partial request filtering. The main loophole is that the Next.js Server Action request with Content-Type: text/plain is not checked by the proxy like the application/json request, so I can send a valid payload directly to the backend action and get the flag.
items.content_html:
TL;DR
Northstar Ops - Web Exploit Writeup is a web challenge from CBD. In this challenge, the targets given are:

Summary

In this challenge, the targets given are:

  • https://northstar.cbd2026.cloud/

My goal is to find weaknesses in the web application and retrieve the flag. After performing enumeration and analyzing the application’s behavior, I discovered that the service in front of the application uses a custom Python proxy that performs partial request filtering. The main loophole is that the Next.js Server Action request with Content-Type: text/plain is not checked by the proxy like the application/json request, so I can send a valid payload directly to the backend action and get the flag.

items.title: SQLi Payload Generator
items.summary: TL;DR SQLi Payload Generator is a web challenge from NCKUCTF. - Category: Web Exploitation - Title: Just a SQL Injection payload generator, More than 100,000 times more useful than sqlmap. - Target: https://chall.nckuctf.org:28134/ Question Information Category: Web Exploitation Title: Just a SQL Injection payload generator, More than 100,000 times more useful than sqlmap. Target: https://chall.nckuctf.org:28134/ Summary Even though the title of the challenge refers to SQL Injection, the main vulnerability is actually NoSQL Injection against MongoDB. The application receives the username value directly from the JSON request, then saves it to the session without data type validation. The session value is then reused as a MongoDB query filter on the main page.
items.content_html:

  • Category: Web Exploitation
  • Title: Just a SQL Injection payload generator, More than 100,000 times more useful than sqlmap.

Summary

Even though the title of the challenge refers to SQL Injection, the main vulnerability is actually NoSQL Injection against MongoDB. The application receives the username value directly from the JSON request, then saves it to the session without data type validation. The session value is then reused as a MongoDB query filter on the main page.
